text:
marie (FinOps): Hey team — noticed a discrepancy on Orchid Health renewal invoice INV-2026-045. Platform fee looks like it was billed at full annual instead of pro-rated for their mid-term private migration. asking for help to reconcile before we send renewal notice
raj (Billing): can you paste the invoice lines or screenshot?
marie (FinOps): here are the lines from the PDF:```
INV-2026-045
Line 12: Private Deployment - Platform Fee - Qty: 1 - Period: 01Jan2026-31Dec2026 - Amount: $120,000
Line 13: Migration proration credit - Amount: $0
Line 20: Support Tier: Platinum - Qty: 1 - Period: 01Jul2026-30Jun2027 - Amount: $36,000
```
marie (FinOps): they moved to on-prem on 2026-07-01 (per contract amendment). platform fee for 2026 should be prorated for Jul-Dec, not full year. :thinking_face:
raj (Billing): weird. our billing system (metering pipeline) should have applied the addendum dates. can you confirm contract id?
marie (FinOps): Contract: RDW-ORCH-2024-A; Amendment: AMEND-17 (signed 2026-06-22). Link: https://contracts.redwood/rdw-orch-2024-a/amend-17
olivia (CS): I worked with Orchid on onboarding — they did request a mid-year private swap. sales confirmed support tier remain Platinum but platform fee change was supposed to be pro-rated. cc @sven
sven (Sales): confirmed on my side. sales ops ticket #SO-1129 to request proration. I thought billing was going to pick this up automatically.
raj (Billing): ok can reproduce issue locally — pipeline flagged the amendment but the proration job failed due to a timezone edge case (amendment created at 23:58 UTC). open a ticket for billing-engine: BE-4983. I'll attach logs.
billing-bot: New ticket created: BE-4983 — "proration job skips amendments created in final minute of day" assigned to billing-engine-team. https://issues.redwood/BE-4983
marie (FinOps): thanks. Orchid needs a corrected invoice before renewal email next Monday. can we get a manual credit / corrected invoice ASAP?
raj (Billing): we can issue a manual credit for the platform fee delta. rough calc: full fee $120,000 -> pro-rated for Jul-Dec (6/12) = $60,000. credit = $60,000. I'll draft the credit memo and updated invoice and route to finance lead for sign-off.
olivia (CS): I'll notify the customer about expected timing and that this is an internal correction, not a pricing change. want to avoid churn.
sven (Sales): 👍 if finance needs approval path, I approve the credit up to $75k for this account.
marie (FinOps): filed internal approval request: AR-6521. tagging @raj can you include the amendment PDF and the sales ops ticket in the memo?
raj (Billing): yes — will attach amendment and SO-1129. ETA: draft credit + corrected invoice by EOD today, final by tomorrow morning.
marie (FinOps): perfect. once credit issued, finance will post reversal and send customer notification. pls ping when BE-4983 is fixed so we can reconcile automated runs.
raj (Billing): will follow up. BE-4983 notes: root cause = off-by-one when amendment timestamp == 23:xx:xx UTC; fix and backfill planned.
billing-bot: Update BE-4983: fix deployed to staging, backfill job scheduled for 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC.
marie (FinOps): thanks team. last ask — please include a short note in the credit memo referencing the contract amendment id and the pro-rate calc. Orchid asked for auditor-friendly detail.
raj (Billing): noted. will include calc: 120k * (184 days/365)?? actually will use months-based pro-rate: 120k * 6/12 = 60k.
olivia (CS): I'll attach the customer-facing note and coordinate send.
marie (FinOps): closing loop: once corrected invoice is out, I'll update renewal docs. :white_check_mark:
